{{Quote|Lieutenant, watch those pinnacles in Widow's Valley. They're unstable.|Palmer, to Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
'''Widow's Valley''' was a valley located near the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Several pinnacles could be found there, and a [[Unidentified Naboo canyon|canyon]] was at one end. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the valley was along the path taken by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Army C]], and the [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] was [[Battle of the south ridge|attacked]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] while in Widow's Valley.

==Description==
Widow's Valley was a valley on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], located near the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The valley had a flat grassy floor, straddled by rocky walls separating it from the grassed areas above. Tall stone pillars were interspersed throughout the valley, and a [[Widow's Valley bridge|bridge]] over a steep [[Unidentified Naboo canyon|canyon]] was at one end.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
The pillars were considered unstable and were knocked down during a [[Battle of the south ridge|battle]] involving the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] near the end of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], a conflict ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] used the fallen pillars to delay Federation [[Army C]],<ref name="Army C">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> while [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] were placed on the bridge to prevent the [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] from passing through to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]] raging on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]]. Sykes delayed the convoy long enough for the detonators to be placed, but they subsequently failed to activate. Sykes used the [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] in his [[NB-1S Royal Bomber|bomber]] to manually discharge the detonators, destroying the bridge and thereby stopping the convoy. Sykes also bombed the [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]] which had been placed in the valley.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Widow's Valley appears during a mission in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', in which the player flies as Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes. The objective of the mission is to stop the convoy, so it is not necessary to destroy the pillars if the player can destroy the convoy vehicles first. If the vehicles reach the end of the bridge before the detonators go off, the mission will end in failure. To detonate the bomb, the player has the option of dropping bombs or using [[Laser/Legends|lasers]]. Also, if playing through the level after the first time, the player can choose to fly in a variety of craft. The article assumes the player uses the proton bombs to complete the objective.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
